newsitem.title: USA: EIP Microwave to be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: EIP Microwave to be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: EIP Microwave Inc on Monday said its common stock is scheduled to be delisted from the Nasdaq, effective with the close of business on Wednesday.
In a statement, the company said it no longer complied with the criteria established by the Nasdaq Stock Market for continuation of listing.
EIP Microwave manufactures microwave and radio frequency test and measurement instruments, which are predominantly used in the telecommunications, wireless and defense industries.
